match: human anatomy or biology — a body part, organ, bone, muscle, skeleton, skull, limb, or a region (heart, brain, lung, kidney, skull, spine, rib, biceps, knee, foot, digestive/nervous system, human body). Also matches a bare anatomical label with no other content.
params: {"focus": "<anatomical name as drawn/written, e.g. 'heart', 'femur', 'hand'>", "systems": ["<optional system ids to show, e.g. cardiac, respiratory — omit to show all>"], "isolate": true|false} — 'focus' names the structure exactly as the sketch implies; omit only for a generic whole-body drawing. isolate=true shows only the focused structure(s); false keeps everything visible with focus highlighted.
